boards.school_name: University of North Carolina at Chapel Hill
boards.title: Zero Dollars: 10 Hangs That Cost Nothing
boards.description: Ten named Chapel Hill places where students can spend time outdoors, see art, or use free UNC student admission without purchasing anything.

cards.title: Browse the Ackland galleries
cards.subtitle: 101 S. Columbia St, Chapel Hill
cards.notes: Meet inside the museum and move through the changing exhibitions at your own pace; check the posted gallery hours before heading over.
cards.short_summary: A free museum visit centered on changing exhibitions and collection displays.
cards.evidence_claim: Ackland Art Museum states that admission is free and lists public gallery hours.
cards.access_notes: Open Wed–Sat 10 a.m.–5 p.m. and Sun 1–5 p.m.; closed Mon–Tue and selected holidays.

cards.title: Explore Morehead’s exhibits
cards.subtitle: 250 E. Franklin St, Chapel Hill
cards.notes: Bring a valid UNC One Card to request free general admission, then explore the exhibits and Science LIVE! offerings included with it.
cards.short_summary: UNC students can enter Morehead’s exhibit areas without buying general admission.
cards.evidence_claim: Morehead says UNC-Chapel Hill students with a valid One Card receive free general admission, including all-day exhibit access.
cards.source_title: Plan a Visit — Morehead Planetarium and Science Center
cards.access_notes: Free general admission is for UNC students with a valid One Card; planetarium shows have a separate discounted charge.

cards.title: Sit with Exhale at 140 West
cards.subtitle: 140 W. Franklin St, Chapel Hill
cards.notes: Use the Town-owned plaza as a meet-up point, take in the Exhale artwork, or pause there while walking downtown.
cards.short_summary: A Town-owned downtown public plaza with a signature public artwork.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town identifies 140 West Plaza as a Town-owned and maintained open space with the Exhale art piece and community events.
cards.source_title: 140 West Franklin Plaza — Town of Chapel Hill
cards.access_notes: Outdoor public plaza; no admission or purchase is listed.

cards.title: Walk Pritchard Park’s trails
cards.subtitle: 100 Library Dr, Chapel Hill
cards.notes: Take the paved or natural-surface paths together and look for the outdoor art; pack only what you need for a dawn-to-dusk visit.
cards.short_summary: A 34-acre Town park with trails, outdoor art, and nature-play features.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town lists Pritchard Park’s trails, art, and other park features, with hours from dawn to dusk.
cards.source_title: Pritchard Park — Town of Chapel Hill
cards.access_notes: Outdoor park open dawn to dusk; use the trails and public features without reserving a facility.

cards.title: Take a lap on Fan Branch Trail
cards.subtitle: 100 Sumac Rd, Chapel Hill
cards.notes: Walk the fitness course along Fan Branch Trail or spread out on the open grass; avoid reservable fields and shelters for a no-cost visit.
cards.short_summary: A large Town park with a fitness course, trail, open grass, and picnic areas.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town lists Fan Branch Trail, a fitness course, open grass, and picnic areas among Southern Community Park’s features.
cards.source_title: Southern Community Park — Town of Chapel Hill
cards.access_notes: Outdoor park open dawn to dusk; do not use a reserved field, court, or shelter.

cards.title: Follow the forest hiking trail
cards.subtitle: 121 Collums Rd, Chapel Hill
cards.notes: Make a short, low-key trail loop through the wooded park, then use the public benches or picnic area before leaving by dusk.
cards.short_summary: A wooded neighborhood park with a forest hiking trail and outdoor recreation features.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town describes North Forest Hills Park as a wooded space with a forest hiking trail, benches, and outdoor facilities.
cards.source_title: North Forest Hills Park — Town of Chapel Hill
cards.access_notes: Outdoor park open dawn to dusk; trail use does not require a facility rental.

cards.title: Hang out beside Booker Creek
cards.subtitle: 600 Kensington Dr, Chapel Hill
cards.notes: Bring a friend to the seating and small grassy area, then take a quiet break beside the tree cover and Booker Creek edge.
cards.short_summary: A small neighborhood green space with seating, grass, and creekside tree cover.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town lists seating, a grassy outdoor-play area, tree cover, and Booker Creek at Coker Hills West Park.
cards.source_title: Coker Hills West Park — Town of Chapel Hill
cards.access_notes: Outdoor neighborhood park open dawn to dusk; use its public seating and grass area without reserving anything.

cards.title: Walk the Meadowmont wooded paths
cards.subtitle: 621 Meadowmont Ln, Chapel Hill
cards.notes: Circle the scenic pond and wooded walking trails, or use the picnic shelter only when it is not reserved for another group.
cards.short_summary: A Town park with a pond, wooded walking trails, and a no-charge picnic shelter.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town lists Meadowmont Park’s scenic pond and wooded walking trails; its fee schedule lists the Meadowmont Park shelter as no charge.
cards.source_title: Meadowmont Park — Town of Chapel Hill
cards.access_notes: Outdoor park open dawn to dusk. The Town fee schedule lists Meadowmont Park’s shelter as no charge; respect existing reservations.

cards.title: Stroll Ephesus Park’s wooded paths
cards.subtitle: 1501 Ephesus Church Rd, Chapel Hill
cards.notes: Use the wooded paths for a conversation walk and pause at the public benches; leave court rentals out of this zero-cost plan.
cards.short_summary: A Town park with quiet wooded paths and public outdoor space.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town describes Ephesus Park as having quiet wooded paths and lists it as a community park open from dawn to 10 p.m.
cards.source_title: Ephesus Park — Town of Chapel Hill
cards.access_notes: Outdoor park open dawn to 10 p.m.; walking the paths does not require renting a court.

cards.title: Visit the Gene Strowd Rose Garden
cards.subtitle: Chapel Hill Community Center Park, 120 S. Estes Dr
cards.notes: Take a slow loop through the rose varieties and companion plants, then use the surrounding park trails for a longer outdoor hang.
cards.short_summary: A public rose garden inside Chapel Hill Community Center Park.
cards.evidence_claim: The Town’s recreation guide states that the Gene Strowd Community Rose Garden is free and open to the public daily.
cards.source_title: Winter–Spring 2026 Recreation Guide — Town of Chapel Hill
cards.access_notes: The Town states the garden is free and open to the public daily; it is within Chapel Hill Community Center Park.
